Added /queryChanges standard-cycle integration test query_changes_standard_cycle_reports_removed_and_added in crate-jmap-metadata-server/tests/metadata_tests.rs.

The test mirrors the spec contract:
1. Seed 2 Metadata objects via direct backend create_object.
2. /query — capture initial queryState and id list.
3. /set — create one new + destroy one of the seeded.
4. /queryChanges from the captured queryState.
5. Assert:
   - oldQueryState echoes sinceQueryState (RFC 8620 §5.6).
   - newQueryState differs from oldQueryState after mutation.
   - removed contains the destroyed id.
   - added contains an {id, index} entry for the created id.
   - added array is sorted by index ascending (RFC 8620 §5.6 MUST).
   - The untouched seed id appears in neither removed nor added.

Mis-attribution note: my staged tests/metadata_tests.rs change was bundled with an unrelated chat-server commit (aad35c1) by a workspace auto-commit hook. The test content is correct and passes; per workspace AGENTS.md Git/Destructive-Action rules I did not rewrite the commit history without explicit user permission. The audit trail for this work is this bead close reason. Suite passes: 27 integration tests + 50 inline unit tests + 3 doc tests, cargo clippy --workspace --all-features -D warnings clean.
